title: Cooking class in Palermo: from the mortar to the cannolo

brief.audience: English-speaking travellers spending 2-4 days in Palermo (couples, friends, families), 30-60, booking experiences on mobile a few days ahead
brief.objective: Cooking-class bookings on risthome.it or GetYourGuide; secondary: profile visits and saves
brief.hook: Chef's hands plating in the first frame + a direct promise: cook with a Sicilian chef in Palermo
sequence: Hook: chef plating cannoli on slate (dolly in)
Beat 1: basket of market vegetables (pan right)
Beat 2: pistachios in the mortar (dolly in)
Beat 3: pistachio pesto pounded by hand (crash zoom)
Beat 4: fresh pasta in tomato sauce (arc left)
brief.cta: Book your class on risthome.it (link in bio)
brief.hypothesis: A step-by-step process reel (ingredient to dish) keeps viewers longer than a plate montage. Success: average watch time at or above 60% of the reel length and at least one booking enquiry per 1,000 plays.

caption:
Hands-on Sicilian cooking class in Palermo with Chef Giacomo. We start at the market, pound pistachio pesto in the mortar, roll fresh pasta and finish with cannoli. Then we eat what we cooked, together.

Book your class on risthome.it (link in bio).
